display.title: Kill the Ignis
display.subtitle: Boss kill
description: Ignis is a fire boss that fights in the Burning Arena, a Nether Wastes structure.
An Eye of Flame, used like an Eye of Ender, points to the arena. Fire resistance helps a lot.
The kill itself is tracked once, in the Bosses chapter. This quest completes after that one; just tick it off.
